SubmarineCapacity.definition: Number of pieces of mail a submarine can carry per trip

SubmarineGasUsage.definition: Amount of gas a submarine uses per trip in liters

BoatCapacity.definition: Number of pieces of mail a boat can carry per trip

BoatGasUsage.definition: Amount of gas a boat uses per trip in liters

MaxSubmarineTrips.definition: Maximum number of submarine trips allowed

MinBoatTripPercentage.definition: Minimum percentage of trips that must be by boat

MailRequired.definition: Minimum number of pieces of mail to transport
